prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production RGBA sprite atlas for a detailed handmade paper pop-up terrarium game. Generate ONE landscape 1536x1024 transparent atlas, exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 individually isolated cut-paper components. No labels, no grid, no backing sheet, generous transparent padding between cells. Front-facing paper theatre scenery, slight elevated view only on ground pieces. All components have visibly thin warm cream paper edges, layered cut colored cardstock, tactile fiber, fine illustrated cracks, deliberate overlapping cutouts and tiny crafted details. Rich charcoal, warm brown, brick red, sulfur ochre, glowing orange/yellow paper lava. It must read as premium hand-cut layered paper illustration, NOT a low-poly 3D render, NOT chunky solid rocks or blocks, NOT photorealistic stone.
Row 1 left to right: (1) a tall irregular asymmetrical narrow basalt cliff silhouette, made of overlapping thin dark gray rock-shaped cutouts, a few small sulfur stains and cracks, no lava; (2) a different tall stepped basalt cliff silhouette facing the other direction, separate layered angular paper fins and thin edges; (3) a low wide distant volcanic crater ridge silhouette, irregular rim with tiny orange fissures, several paper layers, no smoke; (4) THREE individual narrow stalactite teeth spaced far apart horizontally within this cell, each one thin jagged cardstock, orange reflected edge.
Row 2: (1) a freestanding brick-red industrial bunker door with tiny bolts, warning stripes, black inset, flat cut paper steel trim, only door panel no whole building; (2) a freestanding slim red-and-charcoal pipe assembly with a wheel valve and small pressure gauge, intricately layered paper rings and bands, no background wall; (3) a short wide freestanding control console, orange zigzag screen, small buttons and switches, layered paper panels, no walls; (4) one isolated orange-yellow flowing LAVA RIBBON, long vertical stream with several thin overlapping wavy paper strips, uneven silhouette, small yellow scalloped tip, no surrounding rocks.
Row 3: (1) a wide shallow horizontal lava pool/current ribbon, thin overlapping orange yellow red paper tongues with charcoal crust islands, organic irregular perimeter, no rocks behind; (2) a small cluster of dark volcanic boulders, many overlapping thin crag shaped paper plates, sulfur yellow crust spots, flat bottom; (3) a low volcanic vent rock with an obvious dark opening on top, intricate paper layers, NO smoke; (4) THREE separate pale warm-gray paper steam curls stacked on the left half of the cell and THREE tiny separate orange-yellow glowing paper ember diamond flecks stacked on the right half. Clear transparent space between all small elements.
No ball, no people, no Pokemon, no arena, no global cast shadow, no text, no checkerboard baked in. Every element fully contained in its own 384x341 cell, all empty pixels truly transparent. Comparable detail and craftsmanship across every cell.
usage: Unmodified RGBA atlas; geometry selects separate paper cutouts. Volcanic paths, Magma hideout and Mt Chimney.
